## About
Broken Wheel Auto Parts sells quality used parts in Cleveland, right next to Pull Apart. It's a small place run by Al, the owner, and his son.
One customer put it well: buying here is "making a deal with a dude," not dealing with a big corporation. If you need a part, ask. Al told one reviewer there's a very good chance he can get it.
We're rated 4.4 on Google from 88 reviews.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Parts for a wide range of cars, a good place to check before ordering new.
- Rims: One driver who hit highway debris found matching Chevy Cobalt rims here in decent shape.

## FAQ
Q: What if you don't have the part I need on hand?
A: Ask Al. He told one customer that if you need a part from anything, there's a very good chance he can get it.

Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Yes, we offer a standard 30-day warranty.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, we're open Saturday mornings.

## What customers say
- "Had to get both of my right side tires and rims replaced today on my 09 cobalt because I hit a big chunk of debris on the highway which totaled them. Me and a buddy called about 5 different places and walked around pull apart, then we even looked on market place for a while but had an extremely hard time finding any for a half decent price. After 30 minutes we called here which happens to be right next to pull apart and we were lucky enough to get the last 2 09 Chevy cobalt rims for 50 a piece in decent shape. The people there were extremely nice and helpful, the owner also said that if you need a part from anything there’s a very good chance he can get it. No matter what you need for your car I’d check here before spending 100s of dollars ordering new stuff." (Jacob Day, 5/5)
